# Energy Ogre

> > Energy Ogre is a Texas electricity management service that finds and switches customers to optimal electricity plans in the deregulated ERCOT market.

Founded by Jesson Bradshaw with leadership from Garrett Faden and Stuart Percle, Energy Ogre serves residential and commercial customers across Texas by continuously monitoring the electricity market and managing plan switches. The service has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list and partners with organizations including Make-A-Wish North Texas and the Houston Association of Realtors.

## Key Topics

- Texas deregulated electricity market
- ERCOT (Electric Reliability Council of Texas)
- Electricity plan switching and management
- TDSPs: CenterPoint Energy and Oncor
- Kilowatt-hour (kWh) pricing and rates
- Contract expiration monitoring
- Energy savings optimization
- Power to Choose comparison
- Residential and commercial electricity service
- Texas electricity providers
- TDSP delivery charges
- Referral and promo code programs
- Provider of Last Resort (POLR)
- Houston and Fort Worth electricity markets

- [Contract Expiration Reminder](https://www.energyogre.com/contract-expiration-reminder): Service to alert customers before electricity contract expiration in Texas

- [Energy Ogre Refer-a-Friend](https://www.energyogre.com/refer-a-friend-program): Referral program details offering Ogre Points rewards for Texas members
